inputs: Task metadata: repository paths, capability tags, explicit capsule ids, type/owner
A KnowledgeStore, to resolve links and detect superseded decisions
Observed source digests and a date, for staleness
invariants: No capsule field holds more than one line, and every pointer field must be pointer-shaped; embedded source is a construction error.
A capsule's canonical JSON is capped at 4000 characters; exceeding it raises.
Selection returns references, never expanded capsule text; knowledge_refs() is a separate opt-in call.
Every lookup and ranking is reproducible by hand from the query: no embeddings, no similarity score, no database.
Staleness takes observed digests as an argument; nothing here reads the repository or shells out to git.
A capsule links facts, decisions and learnings by id, never hypotheses, and never restates their contents.
outputs: A ranked CapsuleSelection with every rejection and its reason
ContextRefs ready for a ContextManifest; knowledge and test refs on request
SelectionMetrics, integrity problems and per-capsule staleness reasons
purpose: Compact authoritative module, system, policy and project contracts; a deterministic index over them; and a selector that turns task paths and capability tags into context references without expanding anything.
risks: Seed capsules carry no source digests yet, so the source-changed condition cannot fire until a caller supplies them.
A capsule is only as true as its last review; last_reviewed is asserted by the author, not measured.
title: Company knowledge capsules
